title: Update Nellie

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: You're back! Did you see her again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're back! Did you see her again?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Oh, fog and fumes, my heart is racing right now. Did you find out anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, fog and fumes, my heart is racing right now. Did you find out anything?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: It's just that thousands of people die in Vinc accidents every year. Why aren't they ghosts? What else did she say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's just that thousands of people die in Vinc accidents every year. Why aren't they ghosts? What else did she say?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Um, that doesn't sound very factual. What else did she say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Um, that doesn't sound very factual. What else did she say?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I appreciate hearing the cold, hard facts. But...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I appreciate hearing the cold, hard facts. But...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: A memory loop. Of course!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A memory loop. Of course!

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I've heard that it's technically possible to isolate certain memories and have them removed. Perhaps that's what she is! A stray memory!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've heard that it's technically possible to isolate certain memories and have them removed. Perhaps that's what she is! A stray memory!

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I don't know. Grief? Regret?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Grief? Regret?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Well, she's haunting the places she once walked...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, she's haunting the places she once walked...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: It all makes sense. Without a proper host, the memory would be… unanchored. Drifting and condemned to repeat itself for eternity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It all makes sense. Without a proper host, the memory would be… unanchored. Drifting and condemned to repeat itself for eternity.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: If she IS a failed memory transfer - and I’m far from sure about that - then I guess we would have two options.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If she IS a failed memory transfer - and I’m far from sure about that - then I guess we would have two options.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Dissolve her code, or find a way to properly store her memory, like a resting place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dissolve her code, or find a way to properly store her memory, like a resting place.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: She would remain trapped as a memory, but at least the code that makes her wouldn't be forced to run constantly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She would remain trapped as a memory, but at least the code that makes her wouldn't be forced to run constantly.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I don't have the skills to do it. But your Ava could.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have the skills to do it. But your Ava could.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's true. With the Codex, and knowing Yulia’s full name, I believe I could write an instruction which would... undo her code.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's true. With the Codex, and knowing Yulia’s full name, I believe I could write an instruction which would... undo her code.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I don't have the skills to do it. But your Ava could.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have the skills to do it. But your Ava could.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's true. With the Codex, and knowing Yulia’s full name, I believe I could write an instruction which would... undo her code.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's true. With the Codex, and knowing Yulia’s full name, I believe I could write an instruction which would... undo her code.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: She would remain trapped as a memory, but at least the code that makes her wouldn't be forced to run constantly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She would remain trapped as a memory, but at least the code that makes her wouldn't be forced to run constantly.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I don’t believe her code is sufficiently sentient to respond. But you can try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t believe her code is sufficiently sentient to respond. But you can try.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I'm just glad to learn her name. I'll write down everything you've told me. Whatever happens, she won't be forgotten.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just glad to learn her name. I'll write down everything you've told me. Whatever happens, she won't be forgotten.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Only if the code was sufficiently sentient. I don't think it is, but you can ask her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Only if the code was sufficiently sentient. I don't think it is, but you can ask her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Saw her and heard her, thanks to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Saw her and heard her, thanks to you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Saw her and heard her, thanks to you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Saw her and heard her, thanks to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Her name was Yulia Tan. She was a member of an order called The Forsworn, and died in a Vinc accident.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Her name was Yulia Tan. She was a member of an order called The Forsworn, and died in a Vinc accident.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Her name was Yulia Tan. She was a member of an order called The Forsworn, and died in a Vinc accident.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Her name was Yulia Tan. She was a member of an order called The Forsworn, and died in a Vinc accident.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She talked about running away. It was like she was stuck in a memory loop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She talked about running away. It was like she was stuck in a memory loop.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She talked about running away. It was like she was stuck in a memory loop.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She talked about running away. It was like she was stuck in a memory loop.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Her name was Yulia Tan. She had a doomed love affair with a stranger and escaped a mad cult only to die tragically and become a saint.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Her name was Yulia Tan. She had a doomed love affair with a stranger and escaped a mad cult only to die tragically and become a saint.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Her name was Yulia Tan. She had a doomed love affair with a stranger and escaped a mad cult only to die tragically and become a saint.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Her name was Yulia Tan. She had a doomed love affair with a stranger and escaped a mad cult only to die tragically and become a saint.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would someone remove memories of her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would someone remove memories of her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would someone remove memories of her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would someone remove memories of her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So not a ghost?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So not a ghost?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So not a ghost?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So not a ghost?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She was in love with someone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was in love with someone.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She was in love with someone.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She was in love with someone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there anything we can do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there anything we can do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is there anything we can do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is there anything we can do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which are?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which are?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Which are?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Which are?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean delete her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean delete her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You mean delete her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You mean delete her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A resting place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A resting place?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A resting place?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A resting place?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And... deleting her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And... deleting her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And... deleting her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And... deleting her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about the other thing? A resting place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about the other thing? A resting place?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What about the other thing? A resting place?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What about the other thing? A resting place?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there any way we can ask her what she wants?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there any way we can ask her what she wants?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is there any way we can ask her what she wants?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is there any way we can ask her what she wants?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks Nellie.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks Nellie.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks Nellie.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks Nellie.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. Still don't like ghosts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Still don't like ghosts.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. Still don't like ghosts.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. Still don't like ghosts.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The good old memory loops ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The good old memory loops ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The good old memory loops ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The good old memory loops ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's a ghost story, so we need to resolve that. Right?
